purpose: certify all 24 spent four-stage histories by finite forward-reachable codeword separation and exact self-replay, without inverse solving or target-to-all-candidate brute-force decoding
candidate_codeword_rule: for history h=(a,b,c,d), reconstruct z_abc from the exact degree-three ordered interaction basis and evaluate exactly one frozen gradient of stage d; define q_h=z_abc-eta*grad_L_d(z_abc)
candidate_storage_rule: store only FP64 delta vectors q_h-theta0 as temporary NumPy .npy memory maps; do not upload these vectors; delete temporary files after scoring
pairwise_metric: full-parameter FP64 Euclidean distance between reachable delta vectors, evaluated by deterministic chunked accumulation
target_generation_rule: generate all exact four-stage endpoints once through a permutation-prefix depth-first trie; require every leaf hash to match the frozen K23 replay lock; compare each leaf only to its own q_h codeword
certificate: for each history h let e_h=||y_h-q_h|| and s_h=min_{g!=h}||q_h-q_g||; h is certified when s_h-2e_h>0; additional target-noise radius is s_h/2-e_h
all24_pass_requires_all: source one-history forward-reachable smoke is frozen pass
all 24 exact target endpoint hashes match the frozen K23 replay lock
target permutation-trie execution count is exactly 64
candidate gradient evaluation count is exactly 24
all pairwise reachable-codeword distances and self residuals are finite
every self residual divided by max(1,||target||) is at most 1e-10
all 24 reachable codewords are pairwise distinct
minimum certified target-noise radius is strictly positive
reported_outputs: all 24 self residuals and relative residuals
nearest competing codeword and separation per history
minimum pairwise separation and attaining history pair
minimum certified margin and minimum target-noise radius
anti_tuning_rules: do not alter the candidate codeword construction, metric, chunk size, self-residual threshold, certificate inequality, history set, or target generation rule after observing output
do not score each target against all 24 codewords to rescue a failed certificate
do not add inverse iterations, line search, Hessian solves, candidate-specific optimization, projection selection, or learned weights
do not touch held-out confirmation codebooks
do not claim polynomial scalability from this factorial finite-codebook experiment

interpretation.pass: the finite active transition codebook certifies all 24 spent Pythia-14M chronologies despite the frozen passive K3 baseline recovering only 3/24; next work must replace factorial codeword enumeration with a subfactorial local-transition formulation before any held-out or scalability claim
interpretation.fail: inspect the frozen self-error and codeword-separation tables without retuning; identify whether failure is replay error, predecessor reconstruction error, or reachable-codeword collision

interpretation_scope: spent-codebook mechanism and separation result only; no held-out generalization, no scalable decoder claim, and no novelty claim yet
